item.title: C# Unit Testing Frameworks: xUnit vs NUnit vs MSTest vs FluentAssertions vs Shouldly
item.description: Unit testing is a fundamental practice in .NET development, and the choice of testing framework shapes how your team writes, organizes, and maintains tests. The .NET ecosystem offers several mature options, from the modern xUnit to the venerable NUnit, Microsoft’s first-party MSTest, and assertion libraries like FluentAssertions and Shouldly. This article compares all five across architecture, assertions, extensibility, and integration with modern .NET tooling.
